reviews.x: This topcoat works great for me but not on its own. I typically use Seche Vite but it causes shrinkage and dulls after two days. I love mavala products and finally found a combinations that works! 1) Mavala Ridge Filler / 1 coat 2) 2-3 coats of OPI, Marc Jacobs, or Essie 3) Mavala Gel Finish Top Coat 4) Seche Vite  I typically wait 2-3 min in between coats to dry. After a few days I will refile my nails and use Mavala Colorfix to freshen my manicure. The results are fantastic! I've added a photo

reviews.t: The polish Jennifer Lawrence's character in American Hustle just has to have!
reviews.x: That's right - and it does indeed smell like flowers and garbage (likely because it contains benzophine, which is in the benzene helix). But it really is the best top coat available, despite the Hazmat warnings.  And it's great that it is available on Amazon.  Now rich housewives have no excuse to fly to Geneva.  Just don't bring it to Catalina Island; not sure why? Perhaps it is the catalyst for the androgynous asexual fish species featured in other films and the folks on Catalina Island ain't

I have used this product for about 20 years and it is the best top coat.  It seals in the color to prevent chips.  It will also blend minor smudges.  I also throw on a quick coat mid week to "re-shine" my nails.

This IS the Holy Grail of top coats! I love having pretty nails, but stopped painting them about a year ago because they would always chip the same or next day even with Seche Vite top coat. I've had this on for three days now with no chipping! The bottle is small for $12, but worth every penny. I keep staring at my hands. I do a lot of crafts at home and I'm a midwife so I wash my hands and wear gloves a lot at work, which can wear on a manicure.This polish has lasted through me picking at thin
Manicure lasts longer. No chips. Never dulls. A really good product!

I have been using this polish for 12 years. Your manicure stays on and does not chip, and it stays on my toes for 1 month. It's the best out their. I used to be a Nail Tech and still use this for my own personal use.

reviews.t: but it's a waste of time and money
reviews.x: I've been doing my own nails for over 30 years and tried every expensive and cheap topcoat out there. This is the one. I bought it in Italy in 1992 having never heard of it and have been going out of my way to find it ever since. Worth the price. I keep trying other brands (Essie, OPI, Orly, etc.) hoping to find something easier to procure that works as well, but it's a waste of time and money. Mavala ColorFix is the only top coat for me.

I have tried every top coat you can think of and this is the only one that works! My polish lasts at least 10 days sometimes for 2 weeks and I only reapply once after about 5 days. It has a brillant shine and I feel that it makes my nails stronger.

This is the winning combo for 7+ days of no-chip nail polish:  1) Nail Tek Intensive Therapy II 2) Orly Bonder 3) 2-3 coats of color of choice 4) Mavala Gel Top Coat  This top coat is awesome and really looks like gel. I get compliments on my manicure and people think I get them done professionally.  Of note, this will end up looking duller over time. I think this happens with all top coats eventually. I use a cheap one I want to use up about halfway through the week to add extra shine.

I've only been using for a week... but my manicure never lasted one week. I'm still in disbelief! Only problems: when you use it midweek, you have to make it very carefully, and take care of the nais as you have just done them; besides, I wish it was a little less shiny. But still... my nail colour never lasted this long!

I am very impressed with the Mavala products.  My nails have really improved.  You can't use just one of these products.  Start with the top coat and build.  A little spendy, but my nails are growing and now splitting as much.  Worth the work, and $$$ so far.

This is by far the best top coat in the market!  It truly creates a gel-like finish and prevents chipping or cracking for days!  Now I can make all my regular polish look like I just had gels done in the salon!!

I purchased this item awhile ago and in the meantime I was getting gel polish through a salon , but after a week the shine goes away and then when the polish comes off your base nails are damaged and you spend another month getting them back to normal…so I said  going to try this again … I used a sponge and ruff my nails then used a wipe to make sure no residue was left on my nails and polished my nails and finished with gel nails top coat and it lasted a week before a chip …I’m happy with that

I got this top coat originally years ago at a salon in Virginia where I got my nails done a couple of times. I bought some of this topcoat there and no longer live near that salon and have not found it; I was so happy to find it on amazon as I am almost out and other topcoats I have used can not compare.

I just bought this product and used it for the first time.  I can't get over how low odor it is.  The even crazier part is that it smells GOOD to me.  To me, it smells exactly like a grape jolly rancher and that's only when I smelled it up close.  I barely smell it at all.

It sucks.  I'm so mad I bought this.  It's a piece of crap.  It makes my nail polish crack more then if I didn't put anything on.  Don't be fooled; it's expensive and it doesn't work.  If anything; try and buy it from a place that can be returned.

I did not understand the good reviews. I used the top coat mavala colorfix and also used the mavala base coat 002 (top coat, nail polish and base coat) waited for dry between base coat, nail polish and top coat. My nails chips in two days.

I love this product and swear by it.. if you apply a coating of this daily or every other day to your polish it will shine and allow you polish to stay for atleast a week. I've purchased atleast 3 - 4 times already.

reviews.t: Seems this product is old & not new
reviews.x: I’ve ordered this product thru other online sellers and product  was fresh.  This product is not fresh very thick indicates it’s old.  I won’t order thru this seller again.
I love this top coat!  It doesn't crack like some.  Add a coat every few days for long lasting nail polish.  I use Essie "Fill the Gap" base coat. And Zoya polish.
I loved this gel topcoat the first few times that I used it. However, a month later this gel was so thick that it wouldn't come out of the bottle. It was a waist.
Girls Don't buy this garbage After first wash your hands it's "coat" turn on white color and peeled I asked for return, they promised and nothing

reviews.t: You have to use it every other week otherwise it will go to waste.
reviews.x: Superb coating. However the liquid in the bottle will thicken fast. You have to use it every other week otherwise it will go to waste.
Another great Mavala product. Nice, strong top coat...I like 2 coats of it best. Keeps your polish protected and dries quickly.
Love this top coat. It's thin and dries fast but still has ultra high shine. And yes ...it smells like garbage and flowers.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise this top coat for preventing chipping and making manicures last for days or weeks.
Many reviewers describe it as the best top coat they have used, often after trying many other brands.
Several reviewers say it creates a gel-like, shiny finish that looks professionally done.
Some reviewers note the bottle is small or the product is pricey, though they consider it worth the cost.
A few reviewers mention it works best as part of a layered routine rather than on its own.
